readerInvitation.closingInvitation: Begin with the preface and its distinction between entrepreneurial value and the founder mythology. Follow the race and attention chapters before judging the proposed alternative. The collaboration chapter supplies the working obligations behind the language of shared institutions. The final doctrine then asks where a useful commons could justify its governance costs. This is a book for builders willing to examine the institutions surrounding their own effort. Its depth lies in connecting individual pressure with the reusable structures that might change it. Read it to decide what should be built once, so others can stop rebuilding it alone.
